from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import json,requests,hashlib,re,time
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_bank_industry_constraint_source_probe_v1")
def now(): return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def save(name,obj): (OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
ledger=[
{"url":"https://big5.nfra.gov.cn/cn/view/pages/ItemDetail.html?docId=1233335&itemId=915","tool":"web.open","status":403,"error":"Forbidden","raw_saved":False,"retry":False},
{"url":"https://www.nfra.gov.cn/chinese/OFFICE/PDF/1221429.pdf","tool":"web.open","status":403,"error":"Forbidden","raw_saved":False,"retry":False}]
url="https://www.nfra.gov.cn/cn/view/pages/ItemDetail.html?docId=1233335&itemId=915"
assert url not in [x["url"] for x in ledger]
record={"url":url,"tool":"requests","started_at":now(),"reason":"搜索命中的同一docId简体官方载体，未请求过此URL，不作为新根信息。","raw_saved":False,"retry":False}
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 response=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,25),stream=True,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"},allow_redirects=True)
 record.update({"status":response.status_code,"final_url":response.url,"headers":dict(response.headers)})
 response.raise_for_status()
 chunks=[];size=0
 for chunk in response.iter_content(65536):
  size+=len(chunk)
  if size>16777216 or time.monotonic()-start>35: raise RuntimeError("达到冻结单次下载/时间上限")
  chunks.append(chunk)
 content=b"".join(chunks)
 filename="原简体页面_"+hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]+".html"
 (OUT/filename).write_bytes(content)
 record.update({"raw_saved":True,"raw_path":(OUT/filename).as_posix(),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(content)})
 text=content.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
 scripts=re.findall(r'<script[^>]*src=["\']([^"\']+)["\']',text,re.I)
 record["script_urls"]=[urljoin(url,x) for x in scripts]
 record["document_body_present"]=bool(re.search("2025年三季度.*银行业|2025年三季度.*監管",text,re.S))
 print(json.dumps({"简体载体":record,"HTML前段":text[:2600]},ensure_ascii=False))
except Exception as exc:
 record["error"]=type(exc).__name__+": "+str(exc)
 print(json.dumps({"简体载体":record},ensure_ascii=False))
record["completed_at"]=now()
ledger.append(record)
save("request_ledger.json",ledger)
save("01_简体官方载体执行记录.json",{"program":__PROGRAM__,"source_code_edits":0})
